Our approach

How we help every student shine

Personal advising

Academic advisors meet students regularly to set goals, track progress and offer guidance.

Peer tutors & resident advisors

Dormitory study sessions supported by peer tutors and resident advisors.

Data-driven monitoring

Administrators use data and feedback to identify areas for improvement and apply targeted interventions.

Innovative teaching

Hands-on activities, discussion and varied methods to suit diverse learning styles.

Programmes

Primary to Jr. College

English-medium · Primary (un-aided), High School (aided), Jr. College (un-aided).

Un-aided

Primary

Foundations in reading, numeracy, values and curiosity — quizzes, spell bee and early activities.

Aided

High School · SSC

Unit tests, half-yearly and preliminary exams, practicals and Std X board preparation.

Un-aided

Jr. College · HSC

HSC preparation with practicals, Prelim II and integrated entrance coaching.

Competitive coaching

Dream big. We’ll coach you there.

Competitive courses attract extra fees. Extra coaching is also provided for vernacular-medium students who need additional help.

Facilities

Spaces for discovery

Robotics & AI tinkering lab

A hub of innovation where students unlock the secrets of robotics and artificial intelligence.

Science labs

Specialised equipment, with goggles, lab coats and emergency equipment ready and strict safety training.

Computer lab

A digitised computer lab — a gateway to the future for the next generation of tech leaders.

Digital classrooms

A projector and AV set-up in every class, with a pre-designed library of e-materials for teachers.

Library

A vast collection of books and digital resources in the vintage academic block.

Performing arts centre

Music rooms where budding musicians, actors and artists hone their craft.

Faculty & staff

Mentors, role models and pillars of support

Teachers with a passion for their subjects, dorm in-charges who offer a listening ear, and staff who keep campus safe, clean and welcoming.
